items.title: Fetch relay: routines read blocked hosts via a GitHub Actions fetch (docs/relay)
items.why: Four handoffs this week stalled only because the sandbox cannot reach ipo.gov.uk, nhs.uk, data.gov.uk, figma.com. A relay removes the whole class; the metrics routine gets Figma numbers too.
items.proof: handoffs citing 'no egress' drop to zero over the next 7 days; Figma metrics rows fill

items.title: Run watchdog: Telegram line when a scheduled routine leaves no commit/run-log line within 2h of its slot
items.why: The Wed 17:09 build was refused by the usage limit and nobody knew until the owner asked. Silence must be visible.
items.proof: every missed slot produces one 'missed' bullet within 2h

items.title: Weekly ops retro routine (Sonnet): reads RUNS/ALERTS/git log, proposes prompt and tooling fixes as foundry queue items
items.why: Owner 2026-09-24: self-expansion is in scope; nobody currently reviews how the routines themselves perform.
items.proof: ≥ 2 accepted foundry items per month originate from the retro

items.title: Daily metrics routine fetches Figma/Chrome/AMO numbers through the relay instead of failing on egress
items.why: Every Figma row since launch says 'fetch failed: egress blocked'; no purchase/installs data at all.
items.proof: Variables Toolkit metrics rows carry install/like numbers

items.title: Decide and implement what happens when Fable is exhausted mid-week (Opus fallback routine vs fewer runs)
items.why: Refused runs waste the slot; owner's allowance was gone by Wed 17:09 this week.
items.proof: zero refused-run slots in a month
items.blocked_on: owner's call on model policy (Fable-only was explicit)
